plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked Yellowstone geothermal temperature & Taq activity chart from Brock & Freeze (August 1969, J. Bacteriol. 98: 289–297) and Chien, Edgar & Trela (1976, J. Bacteriol. 127: 1550–1557) shows Thermus aquaticus strain YT-1 growing from 40 °C to 79 °C (optimum 70 °C) and purified Taq polymerase reaching peak DNA synthesis at 75–80 °C.
